Details 
#WD Most known taxons
PREFIX rdfs: 
PREFIX wikibase: 
PREFIX wd: 
PREFIX wdt: 
PREFIX schema: 
SELECT ?links ?taxonRank ?obj ?objLabel ?taxonName ?taxonRankLabel ?taxonParent ?taxonParentLabel ?categ ?categLabel ?deepCateg ?wikipedia ?wikipediaLabel  WHERE {
  SERVICE  {
    {
      SELECT ?obj ?links (SAMPLE(?taxonName0) AS ?taxonName) (SAMPLE(?taxonRank0) AS ?taxonRank) (SAMPLE(?taxonParent0) AS ?taxonParent) WHERE {
        ?obj wdt:P31 wd:Q16521 .
        ?obj ^schema:about/wikibase:sitelinks ?links .
        OPTIONAL {
          ?obj wdt:P225 ?taxonName0 .
        }
        OPTIONAL {
          ?obj wdt:P225 ?taxonName0 .
        }
        OPTIONAL {
          ?obj wdt:P105 ?taxonRank0 .
        }
        OPTIONAL {
          ?obj wdt:P171 ?taxonParent0 .
        }
      }
      GROUP BY ?obj ?links
      ORDER BY DESC(?links)
      LIMIT 5000
    }
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj wdt:P373 ?categLabel .
    BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:", ?categLabel)) AS ?categ)
    BIND (REPLACE(STR(?obj), ".*/", "") AS ?qid)
    BIND (ENCODE_FOR_URI(CONCAT("deepcategory:\"", ?categLabel, "\"")) AS ?query)
    BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=", ?query, "&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image")) AS ?deepCateg)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?wikipedia schema:about ?obj .
    ?wikipedia schema:isPartOf  .
    ?wikipedia schema:name ?wikipediaLabel .
  }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "ru,mul,en". } 
}
ORDER BY DESC(?links)
